Name: Seasonal Fences
Author: DustBeauty
Description:
Config options for GateStyle: wood, hardwood, iron, stone.
Default: iron. (The one showed in screenshots.)

Floorings and Paths available here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4852]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4852[/url]

[b]For SVE users, set:[/b]
  "ReplaceDefaultFences": "[b]false[/b]",
  "ReplaceHardwoodFences": "[b]false[/b]",
[b]in "[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded" config.json[/b]

If you want each fence to have their distinctively designed gate, you need to follow these steps:
1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4859]Gate Fix[/url] and put it in your Mods folder along with this mod.
2. Set "GateStyle" to "wood" in my config.json.
3. Place a new gate on a closed fence for it to change the style, and you have to remove the gate first in order to remove the neighboring fence.

[b]The island map is made by me, included in an upcoming story expansion mod.[/b]

Credit:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34984615]Eemie[/url] and [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/rues-creepy-curios-and-spooky-aesthetics-updated-11-7.126419/]Rue[/url]﻿ for their original fence sprites.
[url=http://]yellog[/url]﻿'s building set for design inspiration.

Downloads.Description:
1.2: Removes the snow on indoor fences. Gate fix mod can help you apply all the 4 different gates, read the description to know how to apply.
1.1: Improves base sprites of iron and stone fence, adds 4 seasonal variations to them.
